blocks.html: Which he retained tenaciously; and more still, when the said Bertrande de Rols had received him for Martin Guerre her husband, from whom afterwards, conversing day and night together, it was easier for him to learn more, and to confirm himself better in what the others had told him — denying always, nevertheless, that he was a Necromancer, or had used any charms, enchantments, or any kind of magic.
